correctness.rationale: Both trinomials are nonvanishing on the unit circle, so exponent differentiation is legitimate. The power sums and convolution coefficients are checked exactly, and rational interval arithmetic certifies the signs without treating numerical quadrature as proof.

value.rationale: The endpoint derivatives are the natural transversality constants for the classical minimal three-term majorant reversal. The lower one is singled out numerically but left unevaluated by the motivating primary source; the upper one completes the two-boundary picture. Exact first-order constants are useful for exponent perturbations and are not an arbitrary parameter slice.
